mentions.name: AI agent budgeting sandbox
mentions.description: A developer-facing sandbox providing a budgeting and cost-control layer for AI agents. Agents operate with virtual credits and can temporarily rebalance budgets or split shared API costs, while everything stays under explicit human-defined limits with full audit logs and kill switches. It is intentionally not real money or a financial product, but infrastructure for coordinating agent spend safely.
mentions.problem: In multi-agent setups, agents hoarded resources or exhausted shared budgets unpredictably.
mentions.audience: Developers building and running multi-agent AI setups.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on a developer-facing sandbox for AI agents that focuses on budgeting and cost control, not payments.

evidence.value: I’ve been working on a developer-facing sandbox for AI agents that focuses on budgeting and cost control, not payments.
